dependencyRationale: The model-driven product UI depends on approved screen/design specs, stable component DTOs/actions, the root interface, production resources/assets and Compose preview/test build wiring. Root implementation and data internals are deliberately excluded.
fallbackReason: Compose generated resource accessors and Paparazzi preview discovery are transitive generated inputs, so the complete compose module is included while mutable data/root implementations remain outside the fingerprint.
toolchainIdentity: Gradle wrapper 9.5.1; JDK 17; Kotlin 2.4.10; Compose Multiplatform 1.12.0; Material3 1.12.0-alpha03; Paparazzi 2.0.0-alpha02
